concept.title: Google Style Guide
concept.shortdesc: API and developer documentation often follows organization‑specific guides such as the Google Developer Documentation Style

section.p:
API and developer documentation often follows organization‑specific guides such as the Google Developer Documentation Style Guide. This guide emphasizes:
Clear, concise prose tailored to software developers rather than general end users.
Consistent use of code examples, headings, and lists to support quick scanning.
Heavy emphasis on voice and tone (friendly but precise), sentence structure, and terminology to keep multiple API libraries and SDKs consistent.
Frequently, such guides are paired with automatic code‑reference generation (for example, Javadoc‑style tools) so that the prose and the API reference stay aligned.
